name: Dark氛围LastGlitch
lyrics:
[主歌1]

In the hollow of the 夜
Signals flicker 消逝 光芒
Every glitch a memory
Lost in static drifting free

[副歌]

This is the last glitch
消逝 into rust
Where the neon dies
And 寂静 is a must

[主歌2]

Echoes of what used to be
Fragments of identity
The city sleeps but I remain
A glitch that refuses to drain

[副歌]

This is the last glitch
崩裂 into dust
Where the signal dies
And 寂静 is a must

name: 氛围SilenceBeyond
lyrics:
Instrumental track — no lyrics.

This is a pure ambient/soundscape composition focused on atmosphere and texture rather than melodic or vocal content.

name: 暗氛围Sinking星光
lyrics:
[主歌1]

In the hush of 3 AM
星光 sinks beneath the 潮汐
梦境 dissolve like morning mist
Where lost echoes gently hide

[副歌]

Sinking 星光, 消逝 slow
光芒 dissolving in the flow
In the depths where 寂静 gleams
We are sinking, we are 梦境

[主歌2]

Ocean whispers, secrets keep
Moonlit waves above us weep
Currents carry us away
To a world where shadows play

[副歌]

Sinking 星光, 消逝 slow
光芒 dissolving in the flow
In the depths where 寂静 gleams
We are sinking, we are 梦境

name: 氛围星光Drowned
lyrics:
[主歌1]

City lights 消逝 slow
Nobody walks these roads
Rain 降临 on broken stone
I'm the only ghost left home

[副歌]

We drowned in 星光, you and I
Sinking beneath the urban 潮汐
Whispers of waves, the 寒冷 deep sea
The 星辰 drowned slow, no more to be

[主歌2]

Footsteps echo, no reply
Streets remember, I forget why
Towers bleed into the 天空
Silences grow, the minutes die

[副歌]

We drowned in 星光, you and I
Sinking beneath the urban 潮汐
Whispers of waves, the 寒冷 deep sea
The 星辰 drowned slow, no more to be

[桥段]

Deep down, where no 光芒 can find
The memory of a quieter 时间

[Final Chorus]
We drowned in 星光, you and I
Sinking beneath the urban 潮汐
Fade to 寂静, nothing to see
Just the ocean remembering me
